content.text: In regions where conventional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are inaccessible, digital creators face significant challenges in launching their online stores. This guide outlines a robust infrastructure solution using [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-19|cloudflare]] Pages, enabling you to build a crypto store that operates without these limitations. By leveraging the COREMERCH Edge Commerce Stack, you can establish a fully operational store that supports crypto payments, ensuring sovereignty and control over your digital commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-beats-online-crypto-payments-12|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-behind-selling-beats-online-crypto-payments-13|The Real]].
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often impose restrictions based on geographic limitations, leaving many creators without viable options for monetization. The infrastructure provided by COREMERCH circumvents these barriers through a decentralized approach. By utilizing Cloudflare Pages, alongside NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you gain full ownership of your store and the ability to operate independently from any third-party platforms. This sovereignty allows you to focus on your products and audience without concerns about payment rejections or account limitations.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before initiating deployment, you need to prepare several key components. First, set up your Cloudflare account, which will host your store and manage your DNS settings. Next, acquire a NOWPayments account, which will facilitate your crypto payment processing. Additionally, create a Supabase account for database management, essential for order tracking and product storage. Collect your digital products, ensuring they are ready for upload. Finally, review the Sovereign Blueprint, which provides detailed instructions for deploying your store effectively and efficiently.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Commence by deploying the backend infrastructure using Cloudflare Workers and Supabase. This step involves configuring your database to store order details securely. Once the backend is functional, integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions seamlessly. Ensure that your payment gateway is set to recognize multiple cryptocurrencies, allowing customers to choose their preferred payment method. After setting up payment processing, test your delivery pipeline to confirm that digital products are accessible to customers immediately after purchase. This configuration guarantees a frictionless experience for your buyers.
Achieve infrastructure sovereignty—own your entire digital commerce stack.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your infrastructure set up and tested, it’s time to go live. Launch your store on Cloudflare Pages, ensuring that all links to your product pages are functional and that the payment process is smooth. Make a test transaction using a small amount of cryptocurrency to verify that everything operates as expected. This stage is crucial for identifying any potential issues before promoting your store to a wider audience. Once you confirm successful transactions, you can confidently promote your crypto store and start generating revenue.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your store is live and processing transactions, focus on scaling. Begin by adding more products to your store through Supabase, ensuring to update your Cloudflare Pages configuration accordingly. Monitor transaction metrics via NOWPayments to understand customer behavior and refine your offerings. Consider implementing marketing strategies to attract more traffic to your site, such as social media campaigns or collaborations with other creators. As your business grows, continuously assess and optimize your infrastructure to maintain performance and security.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, start by setting up a Cloudflare account and integrating NOWPayments for payment processing. Utilize Supabase for database management and ensure your digital products are ready for upload. This setup allows you to operate independently from traditional payment platforms, fostering financial sovereignty.
Deploy your online store without relying on traditional payment platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

This guide is part of a broader initiative to empower creators in regions with limited access to conventional payment platforms. If you’re interested in a more comprehensive solution, explore the Edge Commerce Stack for enhanced features and capabilities. For additional resources, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.

What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script, while Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. Stack 02 offers more robust features and is deployed end-to-end tested by COREMERCH within 48 hours, making it the superior choice for creators.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host your digital product store on either platform. GitHub Pages is suitable for simpler setups, while Cloudflare Pages offers enhanced performance and scalability, making it ideal for more complex infrastructures.
What types of cryptocurrency can I accept with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a diverse customer base. You can choose to accept popular coins or niche options based on your target audience's preferences.
How long does it take to set up the Edge Commerce Stack?
